title: Luth: Efficient French Specialization for Small Language Models and Cross-Lingual Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance (Pass@1 scores) across standardized benchmarks (such as IFEval, MMLU, GPQA-Diamond, Math500, Arc-Challenge, and Hellaswag) in both English and French to quantify and mitigate the English-centric performance gap in Small Language Models.
